what: Same-kind scores (lib/texture_compare.py gravel, 1254 dots, normal from make_normal.py at strength 10) of the full-size tuning pictures, seed set 1 only. Written by hand from the printed scores because the scratch folders were deleted to save disk. Tuning looked at these and at the pictures; no optimiser was used.

round_4_run_4.what_changed: first full-size look: straight-edged polygon stones, pale facets, geometric look

round_6_run_6.what_changed: ragged stone edges, subtler facets, patchier stone paint, orange top tone, MOSS out of the stack; height = 0.9 colour rule + 0.1 real relief (mixed from two bakes)

round_7_run_7.what_changed: calmer crumbs and grain, darker soil, less big-patch variation: WORSE (the height lost contrast, the normal tilt score fell from 0.50 to 0.12)

round_8_run_8.what_changed: back to round 6 crumbs, grain and big patches; darker soil colours kept; more pale lumps; brighter lit faces

round_9_run_9.what_changed: round 8 with no paint tongues (fade_direction 0): looked the same, score 0.009 lower (the normal tilt measure), so round 8's settings were kept
